question: Why does the brahman-knower remain unmoved by pleasant and unpleasant?
premises: he does not rejoice at pleasant gain
he is not agitated by unpleasant gain
his distinction of friend and foe is mere convention
inference: inner establishment in brahman stabilizes the mind beyond dual reactions
uncertainties: fused sandhi forms are kept whole
plain_english: The steady, unconfused knower of brahman does not rejoice or grieve at gain; friend-enemy distinction is only convention.
